contentPlacement.insideTools: Accessible unit, plan, view, facility and environment facts generated from one data owner.
contentPlacement.afterDecisionTools: Approximately 5,000 words organized by buyer questions, not a keyword quota.

cannibalizationRules: Only the project page targets the exact project name plus price, plan and apartment modifiers.
The Sde Dov guide owns broad neighborhood queries and links to every project.
Developer and professional pages own entity-name queries and summarize projects without duplicating the project article.
No filter, unit, plan or language fallback URL is indexable unless it has a deliberate canonical and unique search intent.
